excludedFirstAttempt.reason: Bounded Docker log rotated before copying initial captures. Not used to establish the cause or a retrieval rate; container removed.

nativeBeforeChange.scope: Three failing functional cases plus parent failure; display:contents preservation already passed.

findings: Old Firefox captures could mark a 12 KB parser/bootstrap fragment ready before the product body arrived in the same retained tab. A later snapshot showed the document still loading, then interactive with over 8,000 rendered characters.

On five counterbalanced fresh eBay observations per image, rendered exact-marker retrieval was 2/5 before and 5/5 after. Frozen normalized HTML matches were 3/5 and 5/5; these metrics are deliberately separate.
Both GitHub/arXiv controls passed on both images. No expected text was sent to the browser. No default timeout, extra retry, upstream proxy or interactive verification answer was introduced.
limits: Five live eBay rounds are a selected retrieval experiment, not a general WAF success rate, a full API result or hosted parity.

The readiness guard can wait until the existing budget expires for an HTML stream that never completes; any partial capture stays explicitly unready. It does not wait for images/network idle or require readyState complete.
Actual hosted results were not refreshed here.
